Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding state environmental policy act exemptions for air operating permits.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting the scope of the state environmentalpolicy act exemption to air operating permits so that steps leading upto the issuance of an air operating permit are not exempt; and amendingRCW 43.21C.0381.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.21C.0381 and 1995 c 172 s 1 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Decisions ((pertaining to the issuance, renewal, reopening, orrevision of)) to issue, renew, reopen, or revise an air operatingpermit under RCW 70.94.161 are not subject to the requirements of RCW43.21C.030(2)(c).
